subject: Re: Hearthline discovery — alignment, MAP & EoQ timing
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Nash <oliver@hearthline.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Hearthline discovery — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Oliver — really appreciate the time today. Quick recap and a suggested runbook so we stay aligned heading into the quarter close. Attaching a one-page MAP (Hearthline_MAP_v1.pdf).

Key outcomes from today's call:
- Scope: pilot to embed Redwood text-generation for triage and SOAP-note summarization for 2 clinical teams (estimated 8k monthly prompts).
- Success metric: 30% reduction in clinician triage time on pilot users within 60 days.
- Must-haves: SOC2 evidence, data residency in us-west, and an integration window with your API team in April.

Open items / asks for next steps:
1) Confirm budget owner and procurement timeline (who owns PO/signature?).
2) Can your API/integration lead spare 60 minutes next week for a short technical dive (demo + data requirements)?
3) Legal: who should I send a starter SOW/contract to?

Timing we discussed: you mentioned wanting a decision before 2027-03-31 to line up pilot in April. If that’s still accurate, we’ll prioritize a short contract + onboarding slot.

Next suggested steps:
- I’ll send the MAP and a short pricing summary (attached).
- Please confirm procurement contact and availability for tech call by Thu 3/24.

Attachments: Hearthline_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP), Pricing_Summary.xlsx (pricing snapshot)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Nash <oliver@hearthline.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick nudge — MAP + EoQ timing

Hi Oliver — following up on the MAP I sent on 3/21 (below). Wanted to check whether you had a chance to share the doc with the budget/tech stakeholders and whether the end-of-quarter decision timeline is still realistic.

If helpful I can:
- Slide into a 30-min tech sync with your API lead next week (I can bring our solutions engineer),
- Pull together a single-page SOW for procurement to speed review, or
- Provide a short contract template you can hand to legal.

We’re finalizing pilot slots for early April and have a small onboarding queue — I don’t want Hearthline to miss the first wave if leadership is ready.

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Hearthline discovery — alignment, MAP & EoQ timing (internal)

Tessa / Vivek — quick internal note on Hearthline. Haven't heard back from Oliver after the MAP follow-up. Given this is an attractive pilot (healthcare payer + good ROI signal), we should consider a small EoQ incentive to push decision timing:

Options I’m comfortable offering if you approve:
- 10% off first 3 months of committed usage, OR
- One month of free reserved capacity for the pilot (covers onboarding costs)

A couple thoughts:
- If procurement is the blocker, a short SOW + a price lock for 60 days could reduce friction.
- If budget owner is different from the exec we spoke with, need to know that contact ASAP.

Vivek — can you confirm we have margin room on a short pilot credit? If so I’ll draft the language and Tessa can use it in the next bump.

—Marissa
Director, West Coast Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Nash <oliver@hearthline.com>, Hearthline Procurement <procurement@hearthline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Final check — are we still targeting EoQ? (short incentive included)

Hi Oliver / Procurement team — circling back as we close the quarter. I know calendars fill up; I want to confirm whether Hearthline is still targeting a decision by 3/31 so we can secure onboarding capacity for early April.

To remove friction and help with procurement review, we can offer the following limited EoQ incentive if we receive a signed SOW by end-of-day 3/31:
- One month of free reserved capacity for the pilot OR a 10% discount on month 1–3 (your choice).

What I need from you to finalize:
- Procurement contact for paperwork (if different from this address)
- Confirmation of budget owner and PO timing
- If you can sign by EoQ, which incentive would you prefer?

I’ve attached the Pricing_Summary.xlsx again and the MAP for reference. If I don’t hear back today I’ll assume you want to revisit after the quarter — happy to reconnect first thing April.

Thanks for considering — happy to jump on a 15-minute call to remove any remaining blockers.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Pricing_Summary.xlsx, Hearthline_MAP_v1.pdf
